title: Galois group of a field component of a finite torsor
statement: Let K be a field [def-weil-field], G a finite group, and T a finite etale G-torsor over Spec K [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let E be a field with a K-algebra structure and let j:Spec E -> T.P be an open immersion satisfying j;T.pi = Spec(algebraMap K E). Then E/K is Galois and there is a subgroup H of G with a group isomorphism Aut_K(E) -> H. No connectedness of the entire torsor is assumed. This statement concerns a specified component; it constructs neither a decomposition of T nor its field factors and asserts no numerical divisibility.

source.place: Tags 03SF and 03QR; component of a finite torsor, finite separable fields and Galois sets

proof.text: The open immersion j is etale. Compose it with the etale structure map of T and use hj to show that Spec(algebraMap K E) is etale. HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff and RingHom.etale_algebraMap give Algebra.Etale K E. Mathlib Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isSeparable gives separability, and Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free gives finite dimensionality.

For two maps x,y from a nonempty single-point scheme X into T.P over the same base, form (y,x):X -> T.P x_K T.P and compose with the inverse of the torsor isomorphism. The proved source-library lemma exists_comp_sigmaι_eq_of_subsingleton factors this map through a summand indexed by g. Projection onto the two factors shows x;smul(g)=y. If two g work, cancellation of the torsor isomorphism equates their coproduct inclusions; evaluating at a point and applying sigmaι_eq_iff shows that their indices are equal. This is the private proved helper torsor_translation_unique.

For K-algebra embeddings sigma,tau:E -> L into a common field, apply the preceding helper to Spec(sigma);j and Spec(tau);j. Both lie over Spec(algebraMap K L). The resulting translate j;smul(g) has image in j: evaluating the translation identity at the unique point of Spec L proves this for the unique point of Spec E. IsOpenImmersion.lift supplies f:Spec E -> Spec E with f;j=j;smul(g). The base equation and T.smul_pi show that Spec.preimage f fixes K, so it is a K-algebra endomorphism a of E. Cancel j in the translation identity, and use faithfulness of Spec, obtaining sigma.comp a=tau. This is the private proved helper component_embedding_factors.

Take L=AlgebraicClosure K and the constructed embedding sigma=IsAlgClosed.lift. Every other embedding tau factors as sigma.comp a by the preceding helper, so tau.fieldRange is contained in sigma.fieldRange. The Mathlib normalClosure_le_iff criterion and sigma.fieldRange_le_normalClosure identify normalClosure K E L with sigma.fieldRange. Mathlib normalClosure.normal makes this range normal over K. Transfer along sigma.equivFieldRange.symm using Normal.of_algEquiv. Combining this normality with the already proved separability gives IsGalois K E.

For each K-algebra automorphism a of E, apply torsor_translation_unique to j and Spec(a inverse);j. Let c(a) be the uniquely determined translation element. The inverse compensates for contravariance of Spec: T.one_smul and T.mul_smul, together with Spec.map_comp, show c(1)=1 and c(a*b)=c(a)*c(b) by uniqueness. This defines the monoid homomorphism rho:Aut_K(E) -> G. If rho(a)=rho(b), cancel the open immersion j and use Spec.map_injective to equate a inverse and b inverse, hence a=b. Finally take H=rho.range and use Mathlib MonoidHom.ofInjective to obtain Aut_K(E) isomorphic to H. All choices are from uniqueness statements proved in the same file; no field decomposition or arbitrary unproved witness is used.

lean.statement:
theorem field_torsor_component_galois_group
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (T : GaloisCover G (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra K E]
    (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ T.P) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (hj : j ≫ T.π = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K E))) :
    IsGalois K E ∧ ∃ H : Subgroup G, Nonempty ((E ≃ₐ[K] E) ≃* H)
